episodes.title: صدى الرفات
episodes.logline: يواجه البطل ورفيقه تجسيدًا مرعبًا للصمت المتفشي، مما يجبر البطل على مواجهة خسارة عميقة بينما تبدأ حقيقة الرفيق المخفية بالظهور.
episodes.theme: ثقل الذكريات المنسية والشجاعة لاستعادة ما فُقد، حتى بتكلفة شخصية باهظة.
episodes.cliffhanger: بينما يغادران، تبدأ شظية الذاكرة المستردة في التوهج بشكل ينذر بالخطر، ليس بالضوء، بل بظلام داخلي مستهلك، وهمس باسم – اسم يتفاعل معه الرفيق بشهقة رعب، مدركًا أهميته الحقيقية والمدمرة.

episodes.title: صدى الفراغ
episodes.logline: بينما يواجه البطل والرفيق تجلياً مرعباً لـ'الصمت' الذي يلتهم الذكريات، يُجبر البطل على مواجهة خوفه الأعمق من الخسارة، بينما يكشف الرفيق عن جزء من سره المدفون لإنقاذ الموقف، مما يغير مسار رحلتهما.
episodes.theme: أن الهوية الحقيقية تتطلب مواجهة كل من الضوء والظل في الذكريات المفقودة، وأن الصمت ليس فراغاً بل كياناً يلتهم الذات.
episodes.cliffhanger: بينما يلملم البطل شظايا ذاته المبعثرة ويشعر بفراغ مؤلم، يلاحظ أن الرفيق يحدق في شظية ذاكرة مفقودة للبطل، وتظهر على وجهه نظرة حزن عميق ومعرفة خفية، مما يوحي بأن سر الرفيق مرتبط بشكل مباشر بما فقده البطل، وربما كان يعرف مسبقاً عن هذا المصير.

episodes.title: صدى الفراغ
episodes.logline: The Hero and Companion delve into a forgotten nexus where the vacuum's memories are strongest, confronting a manifestation of the encroaching Silence that threatens to erase their very identities and forcing a desperate choice.
episodes.theme: The fragility of identity in the face of oblivion, and the enduring power of shared memory and connection.
episodes.cliffhanger: The retrieved memory shard reveals a shocking truth about the hero's past or the Silence's origin, which directly implicates the Companion's hidden secret, leaving the hero questioning everything they thought they knew about their journey and their ally.

episodes.title: ثمن الحقيقة
episodes.logline: As the Hero finally unearths a pivotal memory shard, its devastating truth is revealed, forcing them to confront a profound betrayal and the encroaching silence that threatens to consume everything.
episodes.theme: The painful cost of truth and the courage required to accept it, even when it shatters one's understanding of reality and trust.
episodes.cliffhanger: The memory shard projects a fragmented, terrifying vision: the Hero's own face, distorted by the Silence, revealing they might be connected to the very thing they fight, just as the void threatens to swallow them whole. The Companion is left behind, seemingly consumed.

episodes.title: شظايا الكذب
episodes.logline: بينما يكتشف البطل شظية ذاكرة حاسمة، يتكشف سر الرفيق المخفي، مما يهدد بتدمير رحلتهما نحو استعادة الذات ويدفعهما إلى مواجهة مباشرة مع الصمت.
episodes.theme: عبء الحقيقة الهشاشة الوجودية للهوية عندما تواجه الذكريات المحرفة.
episodes.cliffhanger: يُحاصر البطل، وحيداً ومجروحاً من خيانة رفيقه والحقيقة الجديدة، من قبل تجسد هائل للصمت الذي يبدأ في التهام ذكرياته، تاركاً إياه على حافة النسيان بلا حليف أو أمل واضح.

episodes.title: قلب الصمت
episodes.logline: As the encroaching Silence manifests as a sentient entity, the Hero must weave together fragmented memories to save their identity, while the Companion's hidden truth threatens to unravel their very bond.
episodes.theme: The resilience of identity against existential oblivion, and the profound cost of hidden truths in the face of ultimate loss.
episodes.cliffhanger: The immediate threat of the Silence is averted, but the Hero's reclaimed identity is disturbingly intertwined with a fragment of the Silence itself, while the Companion's full revelation leaves them both vulnerable and isolated, questioning the very foundation of their quest.

episodes.title: The Shattered Anchor
episodes.logline: As the Hero uncovers a crucial memory shard at a cosmic graveyard, the Companion's hidden truth is exposed amidst a harrowing confrontation with the encroaching Silence, forcing a devastating choice and a new, fractured path forward.
episodes.theme: The painful necessity of truth in forging identity, even when it leads to betrayal and loss.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Hero stands alone amidst the cosmic ashes of dead stars, the memory anchor secured but their trust irrevocably broken. The path ahead is shrouded in uncertainty, the Silence still lurks, and the Hero now understands the true, devastating cost of their journey and the deeper, darker nature of the memories they seek.

episodes.title: Shattered Truth
episodes.logline: As the Hero unearths a crucial memory shard revealing a devastating truth about their past and the encroaching Silence, the Companion's hidden secret threatens to unravel their fragile alliance.
episodes.theme: The unbearable weight of forgotten truths and the sacrifices required to reclaim identity.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Hero, reeling from the personal truth and the Silence's triumph, stands amidst cosmic ruin, their trust in the Companion shattered by the exposed secret, facing an impossible choice between self-preservation and fighting a deeply personal enemy.

episodes.title: The Unraveling Thread
episodes.logline: The hero and companion must navigate a collapsing memory-scape where forgotten truths manifest as deadly physical threats, forcing them to confront a profound loss or risk being consumed by the void.
episodes.theme: The cost of truth and the burden of memory.
episodes.cliffhanger: The immediate memory-storm is quelled, but the sacrifice made by the hero has inadvertently ripped open a new, massive void in the fabric of spacetime, revealing an ancient, silent entity that begins to slowly extend its influence, threatening to consume all memories and stories. The companion lies unconscious or changed, and the hero is left alone, facing an existential threat far beyond their current understanding.

episodes.title: The Sundered Archive
episodes.logline: The Hero races against an accelerating entropic collapse to secure a vital memory archive, only to discover its deepest secrets are guarded by a relentless Oblivion Weaver and the very fabric of reality unraveling around them.
episodes.theme: The fragile persistence of truth against overwhelming oblivion, and the heavy cost of remembrance.
episodes.cliffhanger: The Hero, battered and cradling the fragmented data-core, looks out at the ever-expanding void where the archive once stood. The data reveals that the universe's ultimate collapse is not just inevitable, but intentional, and that the true architect of oblivion has now become aware of their interference, leaving the Hero with a chilling sense of being hunted, their desperate fight now a personal target.

episodes.title: Veiled Remnants
episodes.logline: Hunted through a collapsing memory-world, Lyra must confront a relentless Silence entity that seeks to absorb a vital shard, forcing her to choose between self-preservation and the devastating cost of a forgotten past.
episodes.theme: The true cost of survival is often the memories we sacrifice, and sometimes, letting go is the only way to move forward, even if it means forgetting who you once were.
episodes.cliffhanger: Lyra loses Kael's voice, shattering the shard that contained him, and a Silence-Seeker emerges from the portal, holding a fragment of the shattered shard, confirming it can now track her through the lingering resonance of his lost memory.
